card.name: Linking words before Native American tribe names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, what, an, is just before an expected Native American tribe or nation name or its language word. Seen in web text about tribes, reservations and Native languages.

modes.label: Article before a tribe name
modes.description: The word the or an comes right before a tribe, nation or its language.
modes.example: Barbara Munson, a member of<< the>> Oneida Nation, called on schools

modes.label: Word-origin questions
modes.description: Words like what or an introduce a tribal word that a term is derived from.
modes.example: The term 'Tennessee' is derived from<< what>> Cherokee word?

card.writes: It pushes toward Native-type words and away from Indian, so the next word is less likely to be Indian.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a Native American tribe name is expected, such as in a member of the Oneida Nation.
